questions: How do true-class, positive-class, and deployment-available predicted-class atom rankings differ?
What risk-size behavior remains after a fit-only nonnull gate is placed before CRC?
cells: 11 tasks x 2 historical backbones x 3 model seeds = 66

target_modes.true: the observed class label; audit-only because it is unavailable at deployment
target_modes.predicted: argmax class frozen from the intact input before GradInput/IG computation and held fixed along the entire IG path

target_audit_sample: the same at-most-100 nonempty-rationale molecules per official calibration/test split stored in each validated tie-inclusive score cache
null_gate: fit-only StandardScaler followed by balanced logistic regression on frozen graph embeddings; target is |Y|>0; threshold fixed at 0.5; no calibration/test labels or features enter fitting
two_stage_explainer: Gate-negative molecules receive an empty set. For gate-positive molecules, predicted-class GradInput scores are calibrated only on gate-positive, nonempty-rationale calibration cases.
fallback: If fewer than 10 eligible calibration cases or no corrected candidate is feasible, emit the full graph for gate-positive molecules and mark deterministic_full_set_fallback; do not label that cell CRC-certified.
primary_two_stage_metrics: overall nonnull risk with gate-negative nonnull molecules assigned loss 1
target_metrics: target-specific calibrated risk and retained fraction
numerical equality of true and predicted scores when the prediction is correct
same_run_target_audit: True-, positive-, and predicted-class scores are recomputed in the same execution and batch regime. Historical score caches define the frozen sample and are checked separately for numerical consistency.
provenance_resume: A cell is reusable only when script, contract, imported partition code, task inputs, upstream cell, score cache, checkpoint, runtime versions, alpha, grid, targets, methods, and run mode match; the per-molecule output must also be present with the expected row count.
smoke_isolation: Smoke outputs are written only under a5_target_null/smoke and cannot satisfy or resume a full cell.
interpretation_boundary: The two-stage experiment validates a concrete supervised gate on the studied benchmark distributions; it is not a universal detector of chemically meaningful rationales. Risk remains conditional on a nonempty formal reference mask. Mask-presence versus class-label agreement is reported because this target is identical to the class label in most benchmark tasks.
negative_result_policy: All adverse, null, failed-gate, and misclassification strata are retained.
